verdict.rationale: Canny can push feedback posts into delivery trackers (Jira Cloud, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, Asana), linking them to issues and syncing statuses. Its MCP server lets developers in Cursor or Claude draft PRDs from real requests and build features from them. What moves into the workflow, though, is raw feedback or ideas rather than a managed, approved specification, and any spec must be generated through an LLM. Missing for 10: a first-class spec/PRD object with an approval state, a documented flow that hands an approved spec to developers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
